title: Professor, Associate Professor & Assistant Professor
organization: Maharaja Suhel Dev Swashasi Rajya Chikitsa Mahavidyalaya avam Maharshi Balark Chikitsalay Bahraich
salary_range: Rs 2,20,000 for Professor, Rs 1,60,000 for Associate Professor, and Rs 1,20,000 for Assistant Professor per month

important_dates.label: Walk-in Interview Days
important_dates.date: Every Tuesday and Friday from 10:00 AM to 02:00 PM

summary: Maharaja Suhel Dev Autonomous State Medical College, Bahraich invites applications for faculty positions including Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor on a contractual basis through Walk-in Interviews. Eligible candidates with required medical qualifications per NMC can appear for interviews with a demand draft of Rs 2,000.
eligibility_bullets: Qualifications as per NMC norms and Minimum Qualifications for Teachers in Medical Institutions Regulations, 1999.
Maximum age limit is below 70 years.
No private practice is allowed for the appointed teachers.

how_to_apply_steps: Prepare the application form in the prescribed format available on the website www.asmcbrh.edu.in.
Get a Demand Draft of Rs 2,000/- in favor of Principal, ASMC and Associated Teaching Hospitals Bahraich.
Attend the Walk-in Interview on any Tuesday or Friday from 10:00 AM to 02:00 PM at the Principal's office along with required documents and DD.
